2609.26048.title: FIRE: Failure-Informed Runtime Engineering for Reliable Language-Model Agents
2609.26048.paper_summary: Language-model agents often reach a working solution and then fail to consistently deliver it. We study runtime policies: targeted natural-language instructions and action denials applied by the agent harness at states that preceded observed failures, without changing model weights or the user prompt. With this, keeping capability constant, we observe a meaningful unlock in delivered reliability. Across the complete 87-task Terminal-Bench 2.1 suite, with two attempts per task, policies increase repeated success (pass^2) in all three GPT-5.6 tiers: 50.6% to 54.0% for Luna, 55.2% to 60.9% for Terra, and 64.4% to 73.6% for Sol. Sol's best-of-two success changes by 1.2 points while repeated success rises by 9.2, showing that policies chiefly convert reachable solutions into dependable delivery. We further cover 14 tasks under Terra's frozen portfolio. Policy-guided Terra reaches 71.4%, compared with 64.3% for unassisted Sol, at about half the cost, demonstrating how engineering around models could unlock dependability for a use case. To isolate the mechanism we run a randomized five-arm experiment: real policies reach 61% on eligible tasks, versus 39% without a policy, 36% with a timing-matched sham, and 39 to 43% with generic verification or reconsideration. The intended corrective behavior appears in 22 of 24 coded policy attempts, against at most 14 in any other arm. Runtime policies are therefore a practical reliability layer: they make capabilities an agent already possesses substantially more repeatable.
2609.26048.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型代理通常能夠達成一個有效的解決方案，但隨後無法穩定地提供該解決方案。我們研究運行時政策：針對性的自然語言指令和行動拒絕，應用於代理在觀察到失敗之前的狀態，而不改變模型權重或用戶提示。透過這樣的方式，保持能力不變，我們觀察到提供的可靠性有顯著的提升。在完整的87項任務Terminal-Bench 2.1套件中，每項任務進行兩次嘗試，政策在所有三個GPT-5.6層級中提高了重複成功率（pass^2）：Luna從50.6%提高到54.0%，Terra從55.2%提高到60.9%，Sol從64.4%提高到73.6%。Sol的最佳兩次成功率變化為1.2點，而重複成功率上升了9.2，顯示政策主要是將可達成的解決方案轉化為可靠的交付。我們進一步涵蓋了Terra的14項任務。在政策指導下，Terra達到71.4%，而無輔助的Sol為64.3%，成本約為一半，展示了如何圍繞模型進行工程設計可以為特定用例解鎖可靠性。為了隔離機制，我們進行了一個隨機的五臂實驗：真實政策在合格任務上達到61%，而沒有政策的情況下為39%，與時間匹配的虛假政策為36%，以及通用驗證或重新考慮的情況下為39%到43%。預期的修正行為出現在24個編碼政策嘗試中的22個，而在任何其他臂中最多只有14個。因此，運行時政策是一個實用的可靠性層：它們使代理已經擁有的能力變得更加可重複。
